nodes.label: RCR-001 Ultimate POS Release Baseline and Repair Disposition
Release Baseline BLOCKED
nodes.rationale: The release baseline cannot be proven because PHP and Composer are unavailable in the audit environment, so Laravel boot, locked dependency installation, migrations, PHPUnit, route enumeration and page loading could not run. Static file evidence alone is treated as insufficient rather than inferred as a pass.

nodes.label: 22-Module Enabled Inventory Without Source
nodes.rationale: modules_statuses.json marks 22 modules true and bootstrap/cache holds 22 compiled provider entries, but the Modules/ source tree is absent. Status files and generated caches are explicitly rejected as proof of installation.

nodes.label: ModuleUtil Installed Check
nodes.rationale: app/Utils/ModuleUtil.php defines 'installed' as Module::has(name) plus a non-empty system.<module>_version value. This two-part test is the reason a true entry in modules_statuses.json cannot establish that a module is runnable.

nodes.label: Provider Repair Core Coupling Surface
nodes.rationale: TransactionUtil receipt rendering, SellPosController permissions and redirects, auth/POS/invoice Blade layouts, product repair_model_id filters and transactions.sub_type='repair' all reach into Modules\Repair classes and conventions, making the missing module a real coupling risk rather than a cosmetic gap.

nodes.label: Repair Disposition UNAVAILABLE / INSUFFICIENT EVIDENCE
nodes.rationale: ADAPT, MIGRATE LATER and COEXIST READ-ONLY were all rejected because the checkout establishes only a historical/intended Repair integration surface, not the actual installed module, its data model, workflow authority, or whether live data must be preserved.

nodes.label: BLOCKER_FOR_REPAIR_ONLY Classification
nodes.rationale: Missing Repair source blocks any action extending, disabling, migrating or coexisting with Repair, but it does not block isolated non-Repair work: a Device Registry, opaque QR resolver, label path and controlled receiving pilot can stay outside repair subtype, tables, routes, receipt fields and feature flags.

nodes.label: Runtime Baseline Gate
nodes.rationale: Every runtime check (composer install, PHP platform, artisan, module discovery, migrations, PHPUnit, route list, page loads) is recorded as BLOCKED, NOT PROVEN or STATIC ONLY, establishing the gate that later RCRs must clear.

nodes.label: Missing Evidence Pack
nodes.rationale: Nine human/deployment-supplied items are required before any Repair decision or release claim, including licensed Modules/ source with provenance, a sanitized production snapshot, Repair production counts, deployment route/module lists, platform facts, build provenance, a rollback owner, and the RCR-002 Alpha profile.

nodes.label: Ultimate POS as System of Record
nodes.rationale: Ultimate POS remains the authority for catalog, aggregate stock, transactions, payments and accounting; Recommerce must be additive and module-bounded. This is the architectural premise the reviewed Recommerce document set is judged consistent with.
